correctness.rationale: From the full RESULT.md and Jojić–Panina–Vrećica–Živaljević Theorem 6.1 (full PDF and page screenshot), X_n=M_2(K3,n) is four-connected for n>=4 because capacity sums satisfy 2n>=6+3-1=8; dimension<=5. For a column permutation geometric fixed points correspond exactly to invariant nonempty faces, whose column-cycle orbit has size<=2 due to row capacity; conversely size1/2 cycles give invariant vertices/pairs. Odd n shift action is free; for even n Armstrong orbit-space fundamental-group quotient by the half-turn gives C_{n/2}. The signed inclusion-exclusion count over three row subsets of size<=2 yields B_n=(1-n+C(n,2))^3+n(2-n)^3+C(n,2). For odd n the free regular quotient and four-connected cover yield H_j=C_n group homology for j<=4, with H1,H3=Z/n and even groups zero. Five-dimensional CW quotient has free H5 determined by Euler rank (B_n+n-1)/n. Independently recomputed B5=91/T5=19, B7=2521/T7=361, B9=18901/T9=2101 and checked the integer quotient chain verifier code including orientation-sign differentials and mod-2/5/7 ranks at n5. These finite checks only corroborate the infinite n proof.
